subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding the habit of 'paying yourself first': saving/investing a portion of income before spending on anything else
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two simulated approaches to a paycheck: saving first versus saving whatever's left over after spending
exercise.pictorial: Student matches the 'pay yourself first' approach to its typically larger long-term savings result
exercise.abstract: Student explains why setting aside savings first, before spending, tends to build more wealth over time

misconception_flags: assumes saving 'whatever is left over' produces the same result as saving a set amount first

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
